what: silent faults, and the design decisions the external review produced
silent_fault_definition: it is a fault: something behaved differently from what it was written to do
it was silent: nothing went red while it was live
something else found it, not the fault announcing itself
silent_fault_scope: limitation records only. The decision record holds faults of the same kind and was not classified, so this is a floor over one file, not a total.

silent_fault_ids.S-19: 3B's zero calls were a systematic fault, not a capability floor
silent_fault_ids.S-25: the stopping rule counted a successful read as progress; 736 calls, never fired
silent_fault_ids.S-26: the same output budget was believed to be the same condition and was not
silent_fault_ids.S-27: the band scan ran with the superseded stopping rule and nothing said so
silent_fault_ids.S-32: the endpoint criterion of the stopping rule had never been in force
silent_fault_ids.S-34: the boundary control ran with thinking on, which was not the declared condition
silent_fault_ids.S-35: the two sources of the write set disagreed on one endpoint
silent_fault_ids.S-38: the write-set derivation read an `@app.delete` decorator as a write call
silent_fault_ids.S-42: binding was looked for across the episode instead of inside the body
silent_fault_ids.S-44: `actions.error_class` carried one value; the signal was in the status code
silent_fault_ids.S-45: an index card's condition could discriminate by coincidence
silent_fault_ids.S-46: the fixed-block share in the architecture document was unmeasured and wrong
silent_fault_ids.S-47: the binding context limit was characters, not the token window, and was never measured
silent_fault_ids.S-48: the index's most frequent pattern could be retrieved by no task
silent_fault_ids.S-49: forty-five tests never ran in CI, and two environment differences were invisible locally
silent_fault_ids.S-53: the recorder's mount point did not fire in remote mode, and it was silent
silent_fault_ids.S-54: the state probe had a blind spot
silent_fault_ids.S-58: the 32B measurement ran with two declared conditions drifted
silent_fault_ids.S-59: the 32B result was read off an incomplete set and a binding ceiling
silent_fault_ids.S-63: K-60's ceiling rule existed and had never been applied to the three runs
silent_fault_ids.S-64: unmerged work is the subject of no check; main was a week stale and nothing said so
silent_fault_ids.S-65: the failure index fell behind the corpus and no check noticed
